ask: Is this test fix fine to take once CI passes?
problem: The nightly test for a member's new role failed. It found no recordings on the member's phone.
found: The test is at fault, not the sync change of pull request 364 and not the product. The test expected recordings made by the seed to sit on the phone. A snapshot worker cuts the language every minute, and a phone opened after a cut stores none of the older events. So the test passed or failed by timing.
changed: Nothing people see. The test now records one part on the member's phone first. After the role change it checks that the phone kept those recordings.
why: It keeps the point of the test: a role change must not erase the member's own work. Setting the test aside would hide that. I could not run the browser suite here, so CI must confirm.
touches: One helper gained an optional set-up step. No other test changes.
